page_title: AI Creatives for Any Business, Without Prompting | Sparkiz

sources.entry: Sparkiz.ai - Turn a product link into a ready-to-launch AI video ad (avatars, voiceover, captions) in 60 seconds. #freemium

summary.name: Sparkiz
summary.one_liner: Sparkiz is an AI ad creator that turns a business website, store or app link into finished video and image ads with AI presenters, voiceover and captions.
use_cases: Turn a product link into a video ad
Make image ads for a sale or promotion
Create social media ads without filming
Generate app download ads from app screens
Schedule finished ads to social accounts
Produce ads for a local service or booking business
summary.what_it_does: Sparkiz reads a pasted business link (or a one-sentence description, optionally with a photo) and uses an agent to pick one of 48 ad templates and write the script. It produces video ads with AI presenters or a custom avatar and voice, plus up to 20 image ads per link across formats such as memes, studio shots and booking ads. A built-in video editor lets you change script or voice and re-render, and a calendar schedules posts to Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Pricing is credit-based, with a per-action credit breakdown listed on the page.
notable: Paste a business link and get a finished ad with script, presenter, voiceover and captions
48 templates across UGC, service, app, SaaS and local business ads
Built-in video editor with re-render and ad library
Social scheduler for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
caveats: Credit-based pricing; the page estimates about 25.26 credits per typical video, and actual counts vary with length, regenerations and lip-sync
Voice cloning and some features depend on plan tier (e.g. up to 6 voice clones on a higher plan)
Done-for-you ads and volume pricing are offered only on the top tier
